name: test_expired_contract_blocks_the_original_send_action
description:
Objective: Expired contract blocks the original send action.
Preconditions: Open Contract workflow with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Contract workflow.
2. Expired contract blocks the original send action.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: An application whose Contract expired offers no original "Send Contract".
